text:
emma: Quick sync — customer 'AcmeHealth' asked for actionable Optimize guidance: automatic quantization recommendations per workload, eval-triggered regression alerts, and default batching/caching profiles that play nice with Dedicated. Proposing a 6-week mini-pilot (2 customers) to validate econ + quality. Acceptance criteria suggestion: 1) eval delta <= 5% measured on customer prompt sets, 2) token cost reduction >= 20% (in pilot traffic), 3) no p99 latency regressions beyond +100ms for latency-sensitive routes. Thoughts? :thinking:

raj: sounds reasonable. two notes: 1) quantization quality delta depends heavily on model family and prompt distribution — we need a small spike to characterize per-model deltas. 2) eval-triggered alerts: must avoid noisy false positives. we should define stable thresholds (f1/rouge/embedding-sim) + minimum sample window.

marta: infra constraints: for Dedicated we can expose a config object to set batching targets + cache TTLs per route. default profiles look like: `latency-sensitive`, `balanced`, `throughput-first`. need to map profiling -> autoscaling policies. Also we need a canary flag for rollout.

owen: For runbooks, fallback is essential: if quality alert fires, rollback to non-quantized model variant + notify route owner. Also recommend metric hooks: `optimize.eval.quality_regression`, `optimize.econ.token_savings_pct`, `optimize.latency.p99_route`. Suggest prometheus alert example: 

```yaml
- alert: OptimizeEvalRegression
  expr: increase(optimize_eval_quality_regressions_total[5m]) > 0
  for: 10m
  labels:
    severity: critical
  annotations:
    summary: "Optimize toolkit detected eval regression"
```

raj: for the spike i propose: pick 3 models (gpt-family-like, Llama-like, quant-optimized small model), run 10k prompts from each pilot customer, measure generation-level BLEU/embedding-sim and operator review sample. That will give us expected deltas and noise baseline.

ben: AcmeHealth is high priority — they care about cost but can't accept hallucination regressions. They'll sign pilot if we guarantee rollback + weekly quality reports. I can onboard them to provide prompt sets.

emma: thanks — owners: raj (quant spike + eval harness), marta (config + profile mapping), owen (alerts + runbook), ben (customer onboarding/acceptance). Timeline proposal: 1 week spike, 2 weeks pilot integration + 3 weeks live pilot. Deliverables: spike report, pilot checklist, acceptance report.

marta: also callout: caching TTL tradeoffs — recommend default prefix caching of 5m for chat sessions but allow per-route override. evictions should be visible in console.

raj: one more: quant recommendations should include confidence band (e.g., expected quality delta ± std) and suggested fallbacks. We can expose `recommended_quant_bits` and `expected_delta` in the API.

owen: ops gating: require synthetic load test that proves p95 throughput at target batch sizes and a degradation plan. also add an SLA clause for pilot routes (notifications and auto-fallback).

emma: agreed. I'll draft a short pilot spec doc and create a roadmap card. Can someone add the acceptance criteria to the pilot card and plumb the alerts? @raj @marta @owen

ci-bot: Created ticket INF-3242: "Optimize toolkit mini-pilot: quant & eval-alerts" and assigned to raj.

ben: I'll schedule kickoff with AcmeHealth next Tue and collect prompt suites.

emma: ok moving forward — i'll post the pilot spec later today. :thumbsup:
